messages:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for service inference-api on staging
deploy-bot: env=staging  tag=v2.3.0-canary-202603  commit=9f3ab2d  initiator=Jen R  traffic-plan=5% -> 25% -> 50% -> promote  change-window=23:00-02:00 UTC
deploy-bot: checks=[smoke, p50/p95, p99, error-rate, output-sanity], targeting checkpoint-1 (5m soak)

Alex (infra): Watching p95/p99 and error-rate, will call action if anything drifts :eyes:

Maya: Dashboards pinned: https://dashboards/redwood/staging/inference-api (soak panels ready)

observability-bot: smoke-check: PASS (0m45s)  p95=82ms  errors=0.12%

deploy-bot: Traffic bumped to 25% (checkpoint 1). Starting 10m soak

Sanjeev: Not seeing errors but a small tail-latency blip on replica-group A ~ p99=420ms, investigating

Maya: Logs tailing: `kubectl -n staging logs -l app=inference-api --since=10m | grep latency`

Sanjeev: Found repeated TCP resets from client X causing retries -> short-lived spike. Applying a connection-pool tweak on the client side now

Alex (infra): Applied pool fix and connection backoffs, pausing canary for 5m to verify effects
deploy-bot: Canary paused by Alex (infra) at checkpoint 1+; reason: transient p99 spike. Auto-resume in 5m unless manual abort

observability-bot: metric-update: p99 210ms -> 95ms after client change (3m window)

Maya: Clean for last 3m, no new errors. Recommend resume
deploy-bot: Resuming canary. Bumping to 50% (checkpoint 2)

Jen R: Pinning this as staging candidate: `v2.3.0-rc5` (snapshot tag saved) :pushpin:

deploy-bot: Checkpoint 2 soak healthy (15m). Promoting to 100% in staging. Tag v2.3.0-canary-202603 now running across staging cluster

Alex (infra): Staging looks stable. Approving prod promo in change window 23:00-02:00 UTC. Will coordinate infra health checks

Jen R: For prod let's do a cautious staged rollout: prod-slice-1=2 nodes (5%), prod-slice-2=10%, then 25% etc. @Maya will be on-call

deploy-bot: Prod canary start: env=production  tag=v2.3.0-canary-202603  commit=9f3ab2d  traffic=5% (slice 1)

Maya: Prod dashboards preset for slices, alerting enabled

observability-bot: PROD smoke-check: FAILED in slice 1 — error-rate=0.9% (threshold 0.5%)  p99 elevated
deploy-bot: Auto-rollback triggered for prod slice 1. Traffic for slice 1 reverted to 0%. Notifying team

Jen R: Thanks. Good automation. Keep prod blocked for now while we triage. What's the impact on customers?

Alex (infra): Impact minimal, rollback completed cleanly. No consumer-facing errors reported in the last 10m. I'll open REL-431 to track RCA

Sanjeev: Root cause looks like client X's retry header pattern when combined with certain request fanout produces retry loops at prod traffic. Proposed fix: add a circuit-breaker and limit retries on client side, deploy quick config change then re-run canary

Jen R: Action items:
1) Hotfix client config (Sanjeev)
2) Re-run prod canary with same staged slices (Alex+Maya)
3) If green, promote and update release notes (Jen R)

deploy-bot: Deploy finished: prod canary aborted at slice 1. Latest production-stable remains `v2.2.8`. Thread archived. Follow-up created in #incidents/REL-431 and the release doc: https://wiki/redwood/releases/v2.3.0-canary-notes

Alex (infra): :thumbsup: good catch everyone, we'll regroup in REL-431 thread for next steps

Jen R: Adding a short note to change-log: "Prod canary aborted due to transient retry-loop; staging remained healthy; fix in progress."
